content:
alex: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's capacity drift. TL;DR: short burst -> preemptions -> autoscale lag. Need owners for concrete actions. Postmortem: https://wiki/redwood/incidents/17649-capacity-drift. Action list below — please claim.
jamie: I can own A1 (quota rule adjustments). ETA end of day Tue. Will drop a runbook and PR.
sarah: I'll take A2 (scheduler tuning). Need profiling logs from the incident to validate. @mike can you attach the traces?
mike: Uploaded profiling bundle to S3: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/17649/prof-logs.tar.gz. Observed eviction spikes at 02:13 UTC and a sustained backlog. Snippet:

```
kube-scheduler: evict pod/worker-42 reason=InsufficientGPU
worker loop: backlog=120 -> p95 latency 420ms
autoscaler: scale_up_delay=45s observed
```

tina: For A3 (headroom plan) I propose reserving +15% capacity during peak windows as a short trial. Can we run for 2 weeks and evaluate? ops-bot: please create checklist.
ops-bot: Checklist created: https://hudson/tasks/3479 — reminder scheduled for 2026-03-30.
alex: Proposed timelines (confirm):
- A1 quota tweaks — owner: jamie — due: 2026-03-25
- A2 scheduler tunables + canary — owner: sarah — due: 2026-03-27
- A3 headroom trial (2 wks) — owner: tina — evaluation: 2026-04-06

jamie: Will add PR and link tests. Also proposing an alert: pool_utilization > 85% for >5m -> notify capacity-oncall and open a transient ticket. That should catch drift earlier.
sarah: Scheduler changes I'm planning: reduce preemption aggressiveness, increase eviction threshold flag from 0.05 -> 0.08, and throttle burst preemption window. Will stage in canary cluster first.
mike: Pattern note: many of these incidents follow the same cadence: short traffic burst -> pod evictions -> autoscaler lag -> user-facing latency. Recommend instrumenting "burst_to_eviction_time" and "eviction_to_scaleup" metrics so we can alert on the pattern, not just utilization.
tina: Agreed. I'll add metric request to the roadmap and schedule a small ticket for observability in Q2.
alex: Owners confirmed? jamie / sarah / tina :thumbsup:
jamie: +1
sarah: :thumbsup:
tina: :shipit:
alex: I'll maintain the single action tracker and ping weekly. Tracker link: https://wiki-redwood/capacity-drift/action-tracker. If anyone hits blockers, raise in this thread and tag @capacity-oncall.
ops-bot: Reminder: weekly follow-up reminder set. Next ping: 2026-03-24.
mike: One last note — I'll run a short synthetic load test tomorrow to verify scheduler behavior change before the canary.
alex: thanks all, closing the immediate loop. We'll reconvene after first canary results.
